notes: The verse continues v.32's construct chain, so each *of* falls either to the rectum under rule 19 or to the לְ that stands where the ASV writes it; the competing placement on the substantival article's unit is named in the דָּוָה and זָּב notes.
The suffix on זוֹבוֹ is unrepresented: the ASV writes *an issue*, not *his issue*.
No אוֹ stands in לַזָּכָר וְלַנְּקֵבָה, so rule 14's *whether … or* pair does not arise and each לְ takes the *of* written for it.
